purpose: MCUI substitutes after 3.14 (team-lead decision 2026-10-01: do not limit conservation sources to IUCN and the Korean list). Step 1: the official national red list of another range state. range_state.limitations: A national assessment of Japan, where the species is confined to the Ariake and northern Yatsushiro seas; not an IUCN global or Korean assessment.
